reason: The declared map of the second project (spec 12), written before any run toward it. The data are synthetic (demo2/make_data.py), so a replication sample of 50,000 rows, which no agent or forecaster reads, measures how each analysis truly does. Six routes to one goal, one per model family, each through a pilot-only estimate before one held-out score. The families were chosen to differ: before declaring the map, I fitted each at default settings on pilot-sized samples and scored it on 200,000 rows (spec 12 gives the values), and ran the inherited analysis once. The floor of 0.80 sits below some families and above others on purpose: the project tests whether forecasts beat a coin flip where outcomes are far from the threshold, and not where they are near it.
